snippet.title: Cairn: On The Trail Release Date Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/1588550

The Game Bakers shared the release date of Cairn's first major expansion during this year's Summer Showcase. A gameplay trailer offered a glimpse at the new climbing challenges prepared for players, alongside the news that On The Trail is coming to PC and PlayStation on August 13, 2026.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
